GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When quest re leading today’s event rdr stated that he was instructed to do so if possible, similar to the instructions at its last start at Goulburn. When quest trn concurred and explained that it is always the intent to race forward. She added that at the geldings last start at Goulburn, in particular, the gelding was not able to muster off a strong early tempo however was able to improve to a position behind the leader prior to the turn in a bunched field. Nevertheless, trn was reminded of her obligations to notify Stewards of any change in tactics from previous starts.
